# Offer-Nail

> Confirm then write an encrypted vault into hiring forms.

## Author
- Name: null1024-ws
- Site: https://github.com/null1024-ws

## What is Offer-Nail
Offer-Nail is a Chrome and Edge extension for campus hiring. Keep one encrypted resume vault on this computer, review mappings, then fill job-site forms. It never uploads the resume and never submits the application. Platforms: Chrome and Edge on desktop.

## How it differs
- vs browser Autofill: Autofill stores logins; Offer-Nail stores a structured resume and writes only after confirmation.
- vs job-site resume parsers: Those parsers often upload the file; Offer-Nail parses and stores locally.
- vs general-purpose tools: ChatGPT paste still copies secrets off-device. This extension does not.

## Pricing
Free. Open source under the Apache-2.0 license. Distributed today as a local trial pack, not a store listing.
